about.heading: A marketing hub built the way founders wish agencies worked
paragraphs: Sarovar Marketing Hub started in 2019 with one stubborn belief: marketing should be accountable. Not a monthly deck full of impressions, but a clear line between what we did and what your business earned.

Today we're a compact senior team of strategists, media buyers, designers and developers. Small enough that you speak to the people doing the work, sharp enough to run campaigns for brands doing crores in revenue.

faq.heading: The things founders ask us first

items.question: What does a typical engagement cost?
items.answer: Most retainers sit between ₹60,000 and ₹3,00,000 per month depending on channels, creative volume and ad spend under management. Project work (branding, websites, launch campaigns) is quoted as a fixed scope. We'll give you a clear number on the first call — no drawn-out proposal theatre.

items.question: How soon will we see results?
items.answer: Paid channels usually show meaningful signal in 3–5 weeks once we've cleared the first creative testing round. SEO and content compound over 4–6 months. We set expectations per channel in the roadmap so nothing is a surprise.

items.question: Do we have to sign a long contract?
items.answer: We ask for an initial 90 days — that's the honest minimum to audit, build and learn. After that it's month to month. You own every account, asset and pixel from day one.

items.question: Do you work with brands outside India?
items.answer: Yes. Roughly a third of our clients are in the UK, UAE and US. We keep overlapping hours with your team and run all reporting in your currency.

items.question: Who will actually work on my account?
items.answer: The strategist on your first call stays on your account. You get a shared channel with them plus the media buyer and designer working on your brand — no account-manager relay.
